caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a blue painted surface. The chest has a slightly overhanging flat lid and sits on a scalloped base. It features a single, wide drawer at the bottom, which has two oval brass handles and a central keyhole escutcheon. There is a decorative label area painted in a cream color with red edge detail on the front of the chest, bearing the text “Maria 1823 Knaus,” with floral ornamentation below the text, containing green and yellow leaves. The chest is bordered with a thin red line along the edges. Below the chest, a small scale diagram with numerical measurements is included. The drawing is rendered on a tan background and is framed by a simple double-line border.
title: Pa. German Chest
